steps.name: build and lint in a throwaway worktree
one reviewer per job
steps.instructions: Do only your item's job, against the reviewed version (the item's read commands), never the working tree. The ticket is the text the user gave, after the line that names the PR or branch. Items listed under decided are already judged by a script: skip them. Read the diff of every file in your list and start your answer with one READ line per file read (GAP | file | why for one you could not read). Go through each of your lenses. Answer in result lines only.

steps.name: check each problem again
steps.instructions: Your item holds a few claims other reviewers made (findings and not-met checklist items; one claim may stand for both). For each, restate it as trigger -> effect, then read the reviewed version: the lines it names and the one place that would make it false (a caller, the migration, the config reader, the consumer). Answer one line per claim: CHECK | <id> | confirmed, rejected or unproven | why | sev: | conf: | evidence: | needs:. unproven is kept and shown as not checked; never guess confirmed.

steps.name: settle what nobody decided
steps.instructions: Your item holds one checklist item nobody could decide (job settle). Read the code it needs in the reviewed version and answer CHECK | met | <file:line, why> or CHECK | not-met | <file:line, why>. Only when the code that decides it cannot be read: CHECK | unverified | <what you could not read>. Never leave it as a question for the person.
